summary: Verified the new /board-recruitment-proposal page + direct-project Stripe checkout flow. 8/8 backend pytest cases pass (config unchanged, checkout creates $1,998.50 one-time USD test-mode session with correct metadata/success/cancel URLs, DB row correct, status endpoint idempotent, unpaid direct-project session cannot be claimed as Recruitment purchase (400), Recruit With Rooney still gated 403, all existing SPA routes load). Frontend UI: page renders every required brp-* testid in the exact order (hero → 3 steps → result → timeline '2 Weeks' → investment $3,997 struck / 50% discount / TODAY: $1,998.50 → guarantee with exact copy and NO brp-guarantee-terms-link visible → final CTA 'MAKE PAYMENT AND LET'S GET YOU STARTED' → testimonial section BELOW the CTA). Not shown in nav (nav HTML contains no board-recruitment-proposal link). Clicking brp-cta-button navigates to checkout.stripe.com. Cancelled query param shows exact brp-cancelled-notice text. Confirmed page: no session_id → brp-confirm-missing (no Calendly redirect); fake session_id → stays in brp-confirm-checking polling with no redirect. All 8 canonical testimonials present (brp-testimonial-card-1..8) with prev/next controls; canonical Pastor Cyrena Blackfire Ministries quote verified in testimonialsData.js and rendered. Mobile 390px: no horizontal scroll.
critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking: BoardRecruitmentProposalConfirmedPage polling shows brp-confirm-checking for up to ~20s on an invalid session_id before eventually setting state to 'timeout' (which maps to brp-confirm-failed). Behaviour is safe (no Calendly redirect), but if a user pastes a truly bogus id they wait ~20s to see the failure card. Consider transitioning to failed after 2-3 unsuccessful polls or checking Stripe's session.status == 'open' with unpaid to fail fast.

Non-blocking: /api/payments/status returns 404 for unknown session_ids. The confirmed page swallows this and keeps polling — fine for security (never leaks Calendly URL), but the same fast-fail improvement would help UX.
Non-blocking (pre-existing): several console 401s from unauthenticated /api/members/me requests fire on public funnel pages. Not caused by this change.
test_credentials: Not required — page is fully public. Admin credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md not needed for this build.
seed_data_creation: Test suite creates ephemeral Stripe test-mode checkout sessions + one temporary member (test_brp_<uuid>@example.com) and cleans up payment_transactions and the member after each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The regression file /app/backend/tests/test_board_recruitment_proposal.py covers direct-project checkout, status idempotency, claim-purchase rejection, RwR gating and SPA-route smoke checks.
